name: PDFQuill
description: A free PDF tool => merge, split, compress, convert, rotate, watermark, protect, and more.

paragraphs: PDFQuill is a modern, privacy-first web application for everyday PDF processing. The entire application is built as a 100% client-side React/Vite Single Page Application (SPA). All PDF processing is handled securely inside your web browser using cutting-edge WebAssembly (WASM) ports of qpdf, Tesseract.js, pdf-lib, and jszip—no files are ever uploaded to a backend server!
features: 100% Private Processing: Files never leave your browser.
Authentication & Rate Limiting: Google Sign-In via Firebase. Anonymous users are limited to 2 PDF operations per day. Logged-in users are granted 10 operations per day.
Make Searchable: Convert scanned documents into selectable PDFs using Tesseract WASM.
Extract Text: Extract raw text from image-based PDFs with multi-language support.
